step.actions:
Presence
a. Power on system and check all FAN speed.
b. After boot to OS, remove FAN_1 module, check FAN sensor and SEL list.
c. BMC cold reset then check FAN speed.
d. Insert FAN_1 module back, check FAN speed and SEL list.
e. Repeat test for other FAN modules.
step.expectedresults:
a1. After power on, FAN speed shall be normal speed.
a2. Number of FAN sensors shall meet spec.
b1. Others FAN speed shall be full on.
b2. BMC shall create FAN_1 module absent event.
b3. FAN_1 speed shall be 0 RPM.
c. After BMC reset cold, the remove FAN is 0 RPM and the other FAN speed shall keep full on.
d. All FAN speed shall be slow down to normal level and de-asserted SEL created for FAN_1 presence after FAN module install back.
e. All the FAN behavior status shall be correct.

b. After boot to OS, remove FAN_1 module's FAN 1 connector.
c. Check all FAN speed and SEL list.

e. Install back FAN connector.
f. Check all FAN speed and SEL list.
g. Repeat test for all FAN.

c1. After remove FAN connector, the others FAN shall full on.
c2. BMC shall create FAN 1 speed lower event.
d. After BMC reset cold, the FAN 1 is 0 RPM and the others FAN speed shall keep full on.
f. After insert FAN 1 connector back, FAN 1 speed shall be normal and BMC shall create FAN 1 speed de-asserted event
g. All the FAN behavior shall be correct.

g. All the FAN behavior shall be correct.
